panel.empty_personal: 💡 Tell AI "Help me turn this analysis workflow into a reusable tool" to create your own skills

welcome.hero_title: 🤖 Hello! I'm your AI Analysis Assistant
welcome.hero_subtitle: Tell me what you want to do, or choose a quick task:
welcome.hint: 🛠 Tell me about your repetitive workflows, I'll turn them into one-click personal tools
welcome.example_prompt: Help me analyze last month's sales data and find the product lines with the biggest decline

dialog.title: 🛠 Create New Skill
dialog.subtitle: Choose a creation method:
dialog.hint: 💡 Created skills will appear under "⭐ My Skills" in the toolbox and can be used anytime

describe.title: Describe my needs
describe.description: Tell AI about your repetitive workflow and AI will turn it into a skill
describe.prompt: I want to create a new skill. Please use /skill-creator to guide me through the creation process. I'll describe my repetitive workflow and you'll help me turn it into a reusable skill.

community.title: Install community skill
community.description: Search and install ready-made skills from the community library
community.prompt: Please help me search and install community skills. I want to browse available skill lists, please list some recommended data analysis related skills.

from_chat.title: Create from current conversation
from_chat.description: Save the recent analysis workflow as a reusable skill
from_chat.prompt: Please save the analysis workflow from our conversation as a reusable skill. Use /skill-creator to create it. Save to my personal skill library (~/.claude/skills/) so I can use it in future conversations.

save.temp_desc: Only for this analysis, cleared when session ends
